mapper.select: SELECT version FROM ha_workspace WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT file_path,content_ref,checksum_sha256,size_bytes,media_type FROM ha_workspace_file WHERE owner_key=#{ownerKey} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} AND scope_key='draft' ORDER BY file_path
SELECT version FROM ha_workspace WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ha_workspace SET version=version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ha_workspace_file(owner_key,agent_key,scope_key,workspace_area,file_kind,write_policy,path_hash,file_path,content_ref,checksum_sha256,size_bytes,media_type,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{ownerKey},#{agentKey},'draft','PROJECT',#{fileKind},'SERVER',#{pathHash},#{filePath},#{contentRef},#{checksumSha256},#{sizeBytes},#{mediaType},1,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_ref=VALUES(content_ref),checksum_sha256=VALUES(checksum_sha256),size_bytes=VALUES(size_bytes),media_type=VALUES(media_type),version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ha_workspace_file WHERE owner_key=#{ownerKey} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} AND scope_key='draft' AND path_hash=#{pathHash}
mapper.select: SELECT version FROM ha_workspace_file WHERE owner_key=#{ownerKey} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} AND scope_key='draft' AND path_hash=#{pathHash}
SELECT version FROM ha_workspace WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND agent_key=#{agentKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE ha_workspace SET current_release_id=#{currentReleaseId} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ha_workspace_release WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} AND release_no=#{releaseNo}

SELECT r.* FROM ha_workspace_release r JOIN ha_workspace w ON w.project_id=r.project_id AND w.agent_key=r.agent_key AND w.current_release_id=r.id WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.agent_key=#{agentKey}
SELECT * FROM ha_workspace_release WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id,release_no,release_hash,'' AS manifest_json,notes,created_by,created_at FROM ha_workspace_release WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND agent_key=#{agentKey} ORDER BY release_no DESC LIMIT 100
